deploy-bot: Commits included in this rollout:
- `b7c8d9e0` — Fix KV cache leak — ken — PR #1152 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1152
- `c3d4e5f6` — perf: kernel selection heuristics — priya — PR #1149 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1149

jamie: grabbing canary logs now, will post a short summary in ~5
priya: watching infra metrics (mem, GPU util, p95)
ken: FYI added conservative fallback path for cache misses in this tag

deploy-bot: Canary started (nodes: can-01, can-02) • primary SHA `b7c8d9e0` • author ken • live dashboard: https://internal.redwood.ai/deploys/1845000001

taylor: seeing a small p95 spike at t+30s, looks like batching increased
priya: spike aligns with kernel-selection change, investigating
ken: reverting batching hint on canary nodes: `kubectl -n prod set env daemonset/serving BATCH_HINT=off`

deploy-bot: Canary update: `c3d4e5f6` still rolling; batching hint env overridden on can-02
jamie: thanks — monitor KV RSS after the env flip

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 15% due to KV RSS trending up on can-01. Suggested mitigations: pin pool to previous stable, reduce concurrency, or cut hotfix. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/deploy-rollback
priya: recommend pin -> we've seen this RSS pattern before, safer during change window
jamie: +1 pin for eu-west-1 Dedicated pool; we'll reattempt with quantized kernels in next window
ken: I can cut a hotfix PR focusing on cache prefetching, but pin is fastest to restore SLOs

jamie: actioning pin now — setting eu-west-1 Dedicated -> `v2.3.0` until hotfix validated. Will update release notes with reason and next steps
deploy-bot: Pin executed: eu-west-1 Dedicated -> `v2.3.0` (pinned by jamie). Active pool rolled back; implicated SHAs removed from active targets.
